verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own marketing says it provides ready-to-use assets ("Models, textures, sounds and more that you can just use"), so it has a first-party asset offering. Nothing shows its size, a store or marketplace, or a plugin or package ecosystem for tools. The agent skills and MCP setup docs cover agent configuration, not an asset or plugin ecosystem, so they are not credited here. missing for 10: evidence of a large asset store or marketplace, a plugin/package ecosystem for tools and extensions, third-party contributions, asset catalog depth or documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: Models, textures, sounds and more that you can just use.
